$comment: version: 1.0 — Uniform output from all connectors. Downstream has no knowledge of source.
title: CanonicalJob
description: Unified job model. All connectors must output this schema. Everything after this point is source-agnostic.

external_id.description: Stable source-scoped ID. Format: SOURCE_ORIGINALID. e.g. JOBBANK_4287165

content_hash.description: UUID v5 from title|company_raw|location_raw — used for deduplication

title.description: Job title as-is from source — null if not detectable

company_raw.description: Company name exactly as scraped — Normalizer resolves this to companies table

company_domain.description: Company website domain if available — used for Company Identity matching

location_raw.description: Full location string as scraped. e.g. 'Ottawa, ON' or 'Gatineau, Quebec, Canada'

city.description: Extracted city — filled by Normalizer if not available from source

province.description: 2-letter Canadian province code — extracted by Normalizer

salary_raw.description: Salary as displayed in posting. e.g. '$35-$45/hour' or 'competitive'

salary_min.description: Parsed minimum salary (hourly equivalent) — filled by Normalizer

contract_type_raw.description: Contract type as-is from source. Normalizer maps to contract_type ENUM

apply_url.description: Direct URL to apply. Must be present — without it the job is useless

source_url.description: URL of the page where the job was found (may differ from apply_url)

raw_text.description: Job description text. Brief from search pages, full from detail pages.

raw_html.description: Raw HTML if available — stored in job_contents, not in jobs table

posted_at.description: When the job was posted according to source

fetched_at.description: When this record was fetched — set by connector
